title: The Mizoram Lok Ayukta Bill, 2014
full_text: The Mizoram Lok Ayukta Bill, 2014 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 20141 Act Number: 1 Enactment Date: 2014-08-05 Act Year: 2014 Short Title: The Mizoram Lok Ayukta Bill, 2014 Long Title: The Mizoram Lok Ayukta Bill, 2014 Whereas after the passage of the Lok Pal and Lok Ayukta Act, 2013 (Act No. 1 of 2014) by the Parliament and by virtue of section 63 of the said Act, the State government is under obligation to establish a body to be known as Lok Ayukta within one year from the date of commencement of the Act and the Government of India has notified 16.1.2014 as the effective date for implementation of the Lok Pal and Lok Ayukta Act, 2013 Department: Law and Judicial Department Type: STATE Location: Mizoram TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles Show all section Show All Sections Previous × Act NameThe Mizoram Lok Ayukta Bill, 2014Rules YearDescriptionHindi DescriptionFiles(Eng)Files(Hindi) Close × Act NameThe Mizoram Lok Ayukta Bill, 2014Regulations"YearDescriptionHindi DescriptionFiles(Eng)Files(Hindi) Close × Act NameThe Mizoram Lok Ayukta Bill, 2014CircularsYearDescriptionHindi DescriptionFiles(Eng)Files(Hindi) Close × Act NameThe Mizoram Lok Ayukta Bill, 2014NotificationsYearDescriptionHindi DescriptionFiles(Eng)Files(Hindi) Close × Act NameThe Mizoram Lok Ayukta Bill, 2014Orders" YearDescriptionHindi DescriptionFiles(Eng)Files(Hindi)21-01-2019 NOTIFICATION No.H. 12017/130/2014-LJD/100, the 17th January, 2019. In exercise of the powers conferred under Sub-Section (3) of Section 1 of the Mizoram Lok Ayukta Act, 2014 (Act No. 11 of 2014), it is hereby notified that the Mizoram Lok Ayukta Act, 2014 shall be deemed to come into force with retrospective effect from the 1st day of October, 2016.
